title: ARC-AFFECTIVE
description: ARC-AFFECTIVE investigates attention and cognitive workload estimation using synchronised EEG, eye-tracking, pupillometry and behavioural data. Candidate measures include theta, alpha and beta activity, event-related potentials (ERPs), fixations, saccades, pupil diameter, reaction times and response accuracy. Planned n-back, Stroop and Continuous Performance Test (CPT) protocols will examine session-to-session variability, artefacts and uncertainty in measurements and predictions.
